en: A vintage postcard depicting a historic square with well-preserved buildings featuring steep red-tiled roofs and ornate facades. The center building is labeled as the Stadthaus (Wallensteinhaus). In the background, there is a spired church. Several people are walking or standing in the square, and an old-style pram is present. There are store signs on the right and some trees planted along the street.
